# Municipal Ordinance No. 11, Series of 2017

**An Ordinance Creating the Position of Municipal Administrator SG-24/1 in the Office of the Municipal Mayor in the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon**

Resolution No. 164

## Summary

Creates the position of **Municipal Administrator** with Salary Grade 24, Step 1 (SG-24/1) under the [[Office of the Municipal Mayor]] in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. Per [[Sec-443-RA7160]] and [[Sec-447-RA7160]], the Sangguniang Bayan has the power to create positions necessary for the efficient operation of the local government. The qualifications for the Municipal Administrator are governed by [[Sec-480-RA7160]].

Motioned by [[Esperanza A. Tan]], seconded by [[Adam M. Forbes]], [[Timoteo F. Villaflor Jr.]], and [[Archimedes D. Tarasina]].

Absent during session: [[Carlos T. Gliane II]] (on leave).

## Key Provisions

- **Position Created:** Municipal Administrator
- **Salary Grade:** SG-24/1
- **Office Assignment:** Office of the Municipal Mayor
- **Qualifications:** As prescribed by Section 480, RA 7160
- **Purpose:** To assist the Municipal Mayor in the administration and governance of the municipality
